Mid-afternoon, careful habits for cleaning rounds
New colleagues will find here what to do first
Companion Animal Travel Desk: page topic and purpose. This page explains how to handle animal travel cases with steady care, because small checks protect animal welfare, reduce boarding delays, and keep Aurelia Skyways service calm and reliable. New staff should begin by confirming travel documents, then review the animal's comfort needs with the welfare coordinator, and finally guide the passenger with clear, kind language. Treat each crate as a safety task, not a storage item. Check that the animal can stand, turn, and settle without stress, and look for clean bedding, secure latches, and any sign of poor ventilation.

For rabbit travel, follow the inserted rule exactly. <<FACT F064>> The same careful approach applies when a traveler brings Bubbles or any other pet, and you should match the handling steps to the species and the trip plan. For reptile travel, use the inserted rule exactly. <<FACT F072>> If a crate or document seems uncertain, pause and ask the senior coordinator before the handoff, so no one is rushed into a poor decision. Remember to speak gently, record what you checked, and keep the animal's comfort at the center of every action.

What to remember: careful preparation, clear communication, and welfare first.
